title: Words That Read Both Ways
summary: Check pairs from the outside in.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards, like MADAM.
Find three more and one whole phrase.
points: A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards, like MADAM.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Test a word by reading it from the end.
Short words with repeated letters are good places to start.
points: Test a word by reading it from the end.

steps.title: The method: Mirror check
sentences: Write the word and check the first letter with the last, the second with the second last, and so on.
Numbers can be palindromes too, such as 121.
points: Write the word and check the first letter with the last, the second with the second last, and so on.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: LEVEL, CIVIC, RADAR and NOON are palindromes.
A phrase is A MAN A PLAN A CANAL PANAMA, ignoring spaces.
The mirror check works every time.
points: LEVEL, CIVIC, RADAR and NOON are palindromes.
